questions.stem_en: What does the 'R' in R-C-D-T-F stand for in this course?
questions.explanation_en: Check the Session 1 deck: R-C-D-T-F is the course's own frame for reading any market claim. Your notes carry the exact expansion.
questions.explanation_hi: Check the Session 1 deck: R-C-D-T-F is the course's own frame for reading any market claim. Your notes carry the exact expansion.

questions.stem_en: Who is the 'trigger' in this course's AI rule?
questions.stem_hi: Is course ke AI rule mein 'trigger' kaun hai?
questions.explanation_en: AI = analyst, human = trigger. AI research karta hai; decision aap lete hain.
questions.explanation_hi: AI = analyst, human = trigger. AI research karta hai; decision aap lete hain.

questions.stem_en: Which of these is a course-approved way to describe F&O?
questions.stem_hi: F&O ke liye course ka approved line kaun sa hai?
questions.explanation_en: Course-wide law: F&O = samjho, khelo mat. Awareness only, every level.
questions.explanation_hi: Course-wide law: F&O = samjho, khelo mat. Awareness only, every level.

questions.stem_en: A 'Full Why' must contain at least how many independent reasons?
questions.stem_hi: 'Full Why' mein kam se kam kitne independent reasons chahiye?
questions.explanation_en: Full Why x2 is the mock-portfolio gate: two independent reasons, each one you could defend to a stranger.
questions.explanation_hi: Full Why x2 is the mock-portfolio gate: two independent reasons, each one you could defend to a stranger.

questions.stem_hi: Share kharidne par aap ban jaate hain:
questions.explanation_en: A share is part-ownership. That is why the course asks for a business 'why', not a price 'why'.
questions.explanation_hi: A share is part-ownership. That is why the course asks for a business 'why', not a price 'why'.

questions.stem_en: Which of the 5 AI patterns should you run FIRST on a new stock idea?
questions.stem_hi: Naye stock idea par sabse pehle kaun sa AI pattern?

options.en: Ask if it will go up

questions.explanation_en: Pattern 1 is always evidence-gathering. Targets and tips are never a pattern in this course.
questions.explanation_hi: Pattern 1 is always evidence-gathering. Targets and tips are never a pattern in this course.

questions.stem_en: A broker's note says 'stock will double by Diwali'. Under teen batti this is:
questions.stem_hi: Broker note: 'Diwali tak double'. Teen batti mein ye kya hai?
questions.explanation_en: A promise with no evidence and a fixed return is Kachra. Guesses have reasoning; Kachra has only a claim.
questions.explanation_hi: A promise with no evidence and a fixed return is Kachra. Guesses have reasoning; Kachra has only a claim.

questions.stem_en: 'Revenue grew 18% YoY per the audited annual report' is:
questions.stem_hi: 'Audited report ke hisaab se revenue 18% badha' ye kya hai?
questions.explanation_en: Audited, sourced, past-tense: Fact. Fact does not mean 'buy'; it just means verified.
questions.explanation_hi: Audited, sourced, past-tense: Fact. Fact does not mean 'buy'; it just means verified.

options.en: Spotting scam and loot patterns in a pitch

questions.explanation_en: LOOT-scan is the course's scam detector. Run it on every unsolicited tip before you even read the stock name.
questions.explanation_hi: LOOT-scan is the course's scam detector. Run it on every unsolicited tip before you even read the stock name.

questions.stem_en: How many items are in the six-item gate?
questions.stem_hi: Six-item gate mein kitne items hain?
questions.explanation_en: Six. The gate exists so a stock has to pass the same six checks every time, regardless of how good it feels.
questions.explanation_hi: Six. The gate exists so a stock has to pass the same six checks every time, regardless of how good it feels.

questions.stem_en: If a stock passes 5 of 6 gate items you should:
questions.stem_hi: Stock 6 mein se 5 pass kare to:
questions.explanation_en: The gate is binary. 'Almost' is how the 50% trap starts.
questions.explanation_hi: The gate is binary. 'Almost' is how the 50% trap starts.

questions.explanation_en: Every entry, every time. Discipline nahi, design.
questions.explanation_hi: Every entry, every time. Discipline nahi, design.

questions.stem_hi: 1% rule kis cheez ko limit karta hai?

options.en: Risk per trade as a share of capital
options.hi: Capital ka kitna risk ek trade mein

questions.explanation_en: 1% of capital is the maximum you allow one idea to cost you. It caps the damage, not the upside.
questions.explanation_hi: 1% of capital is the maximum you allow one idea to cost you. It caps the damage, not the upside.

questions.stem_hi: Friday review kis baare mein hai?
questions.explanation_en: Return copy nahi hota, process hota hai. Friday review grades the process, never the P&L.
questions.explanation_hi: Return copy nahi hota, process hota hai. Friday review grades the process, never the P&L.

options.en: Every process mistake, win or lose
options.hi: Har process galti, jeet ya haar

questions.explanation_en: A winning trade with a broken process is still a galti. Log the process, not the outcome.
questions.explanation_hi: A winning trade with a broken process is still a galti. Log the process, not the outcome.
